about: Shahan Ali is a full-stack developer from Burewala, Punjab, Pakistan. Also known online as PROBOY, ProBoy, itx_proboy, shahan315, and proboy315, he builds web apps, WhatsApp bots, and Shopify stores.

At the same time, he studies ICS at Govt Graduate College Burewala. In addition, he maintains the open-source ProBoy-MD WhatsApp bot, builds Shopify Online Store 2.0 storefronts, and adds Google Gemini AI to real workflows.

chapters.title: Who I Am
chapters.text: Shahan Ali is based in Burewala, Punjab, Pakistan, and he is currently an ICS student at Govt Graduate College Burewala. Online he also goes by PROBOY, shahan315, proboy315, and itx_proboy.

chapters.title: What I Build
chapters.text: He builds full-stack web apps with React, TypeScript, and Node.js. He also created ProBoy-MD, an open-source WhatsApp bot with 224 command files. In addition, he builds Shopify Online Store 2.0 themes and Gemini AI tools.

chapters.title: How I Work
chapters.text: He writes modular code and explains his work clearly. In practice, his interfaces stay accessible and lean because small, clear systems are easier to keep.

faq.a: Shahan Ali is a developer from Burewala, Punjab, Pakistan. Online he goes by PROBOY, ProBoy, itx_proboy, shahan315, and proboy315. He is currently an ICS student at Govt Graduate College Burewala, and he builds web apps, the ProBoy-MD WhatsApp bot, Shopify stores, and Gemini AI tools.

faq.q: Is this Shahan Ali the same person as Shahan Ali Mohsin or Shahan Ali Jamil?
faq.a: No. This site belongs to Shahan Ali (PROBOY), a developer and ICS student in Burewala, Punjab, Pakistan. He is not the same person as Shahan Ali Mohsin, the Indian motorsport racing driver, or Shahan Ali Jamil, the EcoPack executive.

faq.q: What services does Shahan Ali offer?
faq.a: Four services: full-stack web development with React, TypeScript, and Node.js; WhatsApp bot development with Node.js and Baileys; Shopify development for Online Store 2.0; and AI integrations using Google Gemini APIs.

ProBoy-MD is an open-source WhatsApp Multi-Device bot created by Shahan Ali (proboy315). It uses Node.js and the Baileys library. The repository holds 224 verified command files in 9 categories, all using a '.' prefix.

faq.q: What credential did Shahan Ali earn in 2026?
faq.a: He earned a Certificate of Recognition for Google Gemini QuizOff 2026. It is dated 19 July 2026 and was organized by CampusCrew and hosted on Unstop.

faq.q: How can I contact or hire Shahan Ali?
faq.a: You can use the contact form at https://proboy.vercel.app/contact, or email shahanali.dev@gmail.com. You can also message him on WhatsApp at +92 326 1684315, or connect via LinkedIn and GitHub.
